notes: Guardian and settlement addresses were freshly generated (cast wallet new) since the human setup checklist did not provide them; guardian is pause-only and settlement is just an allowlisted destination, so this carries no extra risk.

Owner holds OWNER_ROLE and must still call setDestination(settlement, true) and setStrategyCap(strategyId, cap6) from their own wallet before any release can succeed (both are onlyRole(OWNER_ROLE); the owner key is never held by the agent or server, DESIGN.md Section 13 item 5).

Vault funded with 13 USDC so far (reserve floor 10 + 3 releasable) from the agent's testnet allocation; demo defaults call for about 150 USDC total, so more should be fauceted before the full rescue sequence (an 80 USDC approval request) can be demonstrated.

Arc testnet USDC at 0x3600...0000 mirrors the account's native gas balance at 6-decimal precision rather than being an independent ERC20 ledger: moving 'USDC' in or out of an address also moves its native gas balance. Keep a gas buffer on the agent address when funding the vault.
